name: Shillem
title: Son of Naphtali
summary: Shillem was the fourth and youngest son of Naphtali, who was the son of Jacob and Bilhah. He was one of the seventy people in Jacob's family who went down to Egypt. His descendants became known as the Shillemites.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Naphtali
keyEvents.description: Shillem is listed as one of the four sons of Naphtali in the family tree of Jacob's household.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's family goes to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Shillem was among the seventy members of Jacob's household who traveled to Egypt to live there during the famine, when Joseph was vizier in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Naphtali in Numbers
keyEvents.description: Shillem is mentioned again as a son of Naphtali in the census in the wilderness, and his descendants are called the clan of the Shillemites.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shillem (also called Shallum) is listed among the sons of Naphtali in the genealogies of Chronicles.
